description: Can this Solana account pay the fees of N transactions now? When to use: Before sending one or more transactions from a wallet: to learn whether it can pay their base fees without dropping below its rent-exempt minimum. Prefer another tool: To check one SOL or token transfer end to end (use `/v1/solana/transfer-readiness`), or to read a balance (none is returned). Example: solana_fee_readiness {"address":"83astBRguLMdt2h5U1Tpdq5tjFoJ6noeGwaY3mDLVcri"}

address.description: Fee-payer account: Solana wallet address: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 32 bytes

signatures.description: Signatures per transaction: integer from 1 to 10; default 1

transaction_count.description: Number of transactions to pay for: integer from 1 to 1000; default 1

name: solana_fee_readiness

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time

as_of.description: When we read the data from Solana (our read time)

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

commitment.description: Every read is at finalized commitment

slot.description: Lowest context slot of the finalized reads behind the answer; null when none of them carries one, never 0

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

account_kind.description: Fee-payer class: none (no account or 0 lamports), system (System wallet), nonce (initialized System nonce account), other (cannot pay fees)

rent_exempt_minimum_sol.description: The live rent-exempt minimum the rule compares, in SOL: a network figure, not the holder's (0 bytes for system, 80 bytes for nonce); null for none and other, whose rule compares no minimum

required_fee_sol.description: transaction_count × signatures × 5,000 lamports, in SOL (priority fees excluded)

signatures.description: Signatures per transaction (echo of the query `signatures`; 1 when absent)

transaction_count.description: Transactions paid for (echo of the query `transaction_count`; 1 when absent)

verdict.description: not_ready when any reason matched, else ready; unknown is not served (it needs a check that can fail without failing the request, and today a failed read fails the whole request)

title: Solana fee readiness
